svg.text: 4-SU DGX SuperPOD compute fabric: 32 leaves, 16 spines (+ core beyond 4 SUs)
H100 RA: 127 nodes as built (31 per SU + UFM), 1,016 GPUs, 1,020 node→leaf and 1,024 leaf→spine cables

g.title: Spines = (total leaves × 32 uplinks) ÷ 64 ports: 1 SU → 4, 2 SUs → 8, 3 SUs → 12 (RA deploys 16), 4 SUs → 1,024 ÷ 64 = 16.

svg.text: Spines = (total leaves × 32 uplinks) ÷ 64 ports: 1 SU → 4, 2 SUs → 8, 3 SUs → 12 (RA deploys 16), 4 SUs → 1,024 ÷ 64 = 16.
Inter-SU traffic always crosses a spine; rail optimization keeps same-rail, same-SU traffic on the leaf.
Storage, in-band and OOB are separate fabrics with their own switches (see Figure 1.2-6).
